final: WITH r AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB*1.0/HCT) AS ratio, AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic FROM Laboratory WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL AND HCT <> 0 GROUP BY ID), g AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS gavg FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.avg_pic) AS mean_avg_pic, AVG(r.ratio) AS mean_ratio, AVG(r.ratio - g.gavg) AS mean_excess FROM r, g WHERE r.ratio > g.gavg
